theme.disclosure: Interface palettes are a Premium feature. Your choice is saved to your CoutureCast account and applies on every device you sign in on. A palette changes colors only: it never changes which outfits are recommended. CoutureCast sends the palette you picked to its analytics provider under a pseudonymous id; no wardrobe photos or personal details are shared.

palette.intro: Find the makeup shades and accessories that suit your tones. Premium reads your wardrobe colors, or one selfie you choose to share, and keeps only the result.

consent.title: Color analysis consent
consent.body: CoutureCast only reads an image after you say yes here. A selfie is analyzed on CoutureCast's servers and the photo is deleted the moment the analysis finishes, success or failure; only your undertone, your depth and a confidence score are kept. Withdraw consent at any time and everything derived from it is erased too.
consent.revoke: Withdraw consent and erase my palette

source.selfieHint: One centered, evenly lit, unfiltered photo of your face gives both an undertone and a depth. The photo is deleted as soon as the analysis ends.
source.wardrobeHint: No upload needed. CoutureCast reads the colors already stored for your garments and reports an undertone only.

failure.noFace: We could not find enough skin tone in that photo. Try a centered, evenly lit shot with your face filling the frame.
failure.lowQuality: That photo was too dim, too filtered or too uneven to read confidently. Try again in even daylight without filters.
failure.privacyViolation: That photo cannot be analyzed. Choose a different photo of yourself.
failure.insufficientWardrobe: Your wardrobe does not have enough colorful garments yet. Add a few more, or use a selfie instead.
failure.timeout: The analysis took too long and was stopped. Try again in a moment.
failure.storageError: We could not read the uploaded photo. Try again.

palette.foundationDepthUnknown: Wardrobe colors show your undertone but not your skin depth, so foundation is a shade family rather than an exact match. A selfie would narrow it to one shade.

sponsored.disclosure: Sponsored. CoutureCast earns a commission if you buy through this link. It does not change which shades are recommended, and you can turn sponsored links off in Settings.
